name: real-crew
title: A real Cattain starts a crew thread, rests, is woken by it and updates its digest
about: Real model calls (the cheapest model). In miso's own thread the person asks for one crew thread with a tiny brief; the real Claude Code calls Neko's start_crew_thread, ends its turn, the crew thread runs and finishes, miso is woken with the crew news and writes its DIGEST.md. Only the real CLI can show a Cattain uses its crew tools and is woken as told.

steps.text: Start exactly one crew thread titled Say ready, with the brief: reply with the single word ready. Do not do it yourself. When it reports, write one line into your DIGEST.md saying: crew checked. Then reply in one line.

steps.expect: miso starts the crew thread, is woken when it finishes, and writes its digest
miso's thread shows it was woken by its crew thread

steps.name: crew-woken
steps.expect: miso after the crew thread reported
